BiblicalUsage: Kariy is the life-guardsman — the Carites, the king's bodyguard, the men Jehoiada called to guard the child Joash in the temple, and who brought the young king out and set him on the throne of Judah. They kept the king safe while the usurper ruled, and they set him on the throne when the time came.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Carites show that God guards His anointed: while Athaliah ruled the land, the guard kept the child king safe in the temple, and the throne was kept for the line of David. The throne was kept, and the king was kept, and both were God's doing.
